description: Render music as a PCM16 mono WAV: notes written as for create_midi, or a MIDI file or a ProTracker module (MOD) given as file_base64 or storage_id. A small synthesizer plays the notes with an instrument family for each General MIDI program and drums on channel 10. At most 180 seconds of sound, a WAV of at most 7938044 bytes; a longer or denser song is cut and truncated says so. A WAV over 4 MiB, about 95 seconds, is kept in Storage for 24 hours and answered as storage_id and storage_url instead of inline audio. No API key, no account and no sign up.

file_base64.description: The file as standard base64, at most about 190 KB of file through MCP. For a larger file, store it with REST POST /services/v1/storage first and pass storage_id.

program.description: The General MIDI program for notes, 0 (the grand piano) by default.

storage_id.description: A storage_id from store_file, from a previous tool result, or from REST /storage. Objects expire 24 hours after they were stored.

tempo.description: Beats a minute for notes, 120 by default.

name: render_audio
title: Render music as sound
